title: Pro-etale local finite freeness at common rational coefficient stages
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ an algebraic closure, $X$ a scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible, and $K\in D^b_c(X,\Omega)$ in the common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Use the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the completed integral coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], their module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the integral constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], raw rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define $K$ to be lisse of finite rank if a pro-etale covering $\{V_i\to X\}$ makes $K|_{V_i}$ isomorphic to the common-stage image of the rationalization of an integral constructible object isomorphic to $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E_i,V_i}^{r_i}[0]$ for some finite coefficient stage $E_i$ and integer $r_i\ge0$. The ranks and stages may vary with the chart. No global integral lattice, and no lattice invariant under an additional Weil isomorphism, is required.
